segments.text: A safety survey is a tool we use to proactively identify hazards and the corrective actions
segments.zh: 安全检查是一种工具，我们用它来主动识别危害以及

segments.text: we need to take.
segments.zh: 我们需要采取的纠正措施。

segments.text: Regular surveys are an important part of a company's occupational health and safety program.
segments.zh: 定期检查是公司职业健康安全计划的重要组成部分。

segments.text: You're going to have a chance to practice.
segments.zh: 你们将有机会进行练习。

segments.text: Your instructor will give you a survey checklist.
segments.zh: 你的老师会发给你一份检查清单。

segments.text: But pay close attention because your instructor is sneaky and may have planted some hidden
segments.zh: 但要仔细留意，因为你的老师很狡猾，可能事先布置了一些隐藏的

segments.text: hazards.
segments.zh: 危险。

segments.text: With this video, I want to share with you a few examples of the sort of things you'll
segments.zh: 在这个视频里，我想和你们分享几个例子，说明你们

segments.text: be looking for.
segments.zh: 要找的是哪类东西。

segments.text: Let's head into the lab and begin our survey.
segments.zh: 我们进实验室开始检查吧。

segments.text: Let's start with PPE.
segments.zh: 先从个人防护装备开始。

segments.text: Lisa is wearing a lab coat, safety glasses, and gloves, which is always required for general
segments.zh: Lisa 穿着实验服，戴着安全眼镜和手套，这是一般实验室工作

segments.text: lab work.
segments.zh: 始终要求的。

segments.text: She's also dressed appropriately.
segments.zh: 她的着装也很得体。

segments.text: Closed-toed shoes, no jewelry, and her hair is tied back.
segments.zh: 穿着不露脚趾的鞋子，没戴首饰，头发也扎起来了。

segments.text: You may need special PPE, depending on the work you're doing, like these heat-resistant
segments.zh: 根据你所做的工作，你可能需要特殊的个人防护装备，比如这种耐热

segments.text: gloves for opening the autoclave.
segments.zh: 手套，用于打开高压灭菌器。

segments.text: That's PPE.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备就是这些。

segments.text: Now let's look at some lab equipment.
segments.zh: 现在我们来看看一些实验室设备。

segments.text: All equipment should be tested and certified to be sure it's in good working order.
segments.zh: 所有设备都应经过检测和认证，以确保其工作状态良好。

segments.text: Fume hoods and biological safety cabinets look similar, but their functions are actually
segments.zh: 通风柜和生物安全柜看起来很像，但它们的功能其实

segments.text: quite different.
segments.zh: 大不相同。

segments.text: A fume hood is used to protect you when working with toxic chemicals.
segments.zh: 通风柜用于在你处理有毒化学品时保护你。

segments.text: The airflow moves the vapors away from you, through a duct, and safely outside of a facility.
segments.zh: 气流把蒸气从你身边带走，通过管道，安全地排到设施外面。

segments.text: This tag lets us know that the cabinet has been inspected and certified.
segments.zh: 这个标签告诉我们，这台柜子已经过检查和认证。

segments.text: A biological safety cabinet is used for working with infectious bacterial agents.
segments.zh: 生物安全柜用于处理具有传染性的细菌病原体。

segments.text: The air flows through a HEPA filter to create a clean working environment, so it protects
segments.zh: 空气流经 HEPA 过滤器，形成洁净的工作环境，所以它既保护

segments.text: you, but also protects your work from contamination.
segments.zh: 你，也保护你的实验免受污染。

segments.text: This tag lets us know that the cabinet has been inspected and certified.
segments.zh: 这个标签告诉我们，这台柜子已经过检查和认证。

segments.text: Now let's look at some emergency gear.
segments.zh: 现在我们来看看一些应急装备。

segments.text: Know the location of your safety shower and eyewash station.
segments.zh: 要知道你的紧急喷淋装置和洗眼器在哪里。

segments.text: Fire extinguisher and first aid kit.
segments.zh: 灭火器和急救箱也是。

segments.text: These areas must be kept clear of obstacles so you can get to them fast.
segments.zh: 这些区域必须保持畅通无阻，这样你才能快速到达。

segments.text: Safety equipment also has to be regularly inspected and tagged.
segments.zh: 安全设备也必须定期检查并挂上标签。

segments.text: Be familiar with the emergency evacuation plan.
segments.zh: 要熟悉紧急疏散计划。

segments.text: An exit should be clear and marked.
segments.zh: 出口应畅通并有标识。

segments.text: Next is chemical safety.
segments.zh: 接下来是化学品安全。

segments.text: All chemicals in the lab must be labeled and organized.
segments.zh: 实验室里的所有化学品都必须贴好标签并摆放有序。

segments.text: Labels provide important safety information like the chemical's properties, the manufacturer,
segments.zh: 标签提供了重要的安全信息，比如化学品的性质、生产商、

segments.text: hazards, PPE, and storage requirements.
segments.zh: 危害、个人防护装备和储存要求。

segments.text: You can find even more details about the chemicals by looking at the safety data sheets.
segments.zh: 查看安全技术说明书，你还能找到关于这些化学品的更多细节。

segments.text: Finally, let's survey some basic lab housekeeping requirements.
segments.zh: 最后，我们来检查一些基本的实验室整理整顿要求。

segments.text: Always clean up after yourself.
segments.zh: 始终要自己收拾干净。

segments.text: The lab should be organized and free of clutter.
segments.zh: 实验室应整齐有序，没有杂乱物品。

segments.text: Walkways should be clear of obstacles.
segments.zh: 通道应畅通，没有障碍物。

segments.text: Never bring food or drink in the lab, unless the food is being used for an experiment.
segments.zh: 绝不要把食物或饮料带进实验室，除非这些食物是用于实验的。

segments.text: In that case, it should be labeled for lab use only.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，它应该贴上“仅限实验室使用”的标签。

segments.text: Dispose biological wastes in the container labeled with the appropriate biohazard symbol.
segments.zh: 把生物废弃物丢弃到贴有相应生物危害标志的容器中。

segments.text: Clean your equipment and workbench after each experiment.
segments.zh: 每次实验后都要清洁你的设备和实验台。

segments.text: And always place sharp objects like broken glassware in a sealable, puncture-proof container.
segments.zh: 还要始终把尖锐物品，比如破碎的玻璃器皿，放进可密封、防刺穿的容器里。

segments.text: These are just a handful of the items on your safety survey checklist.
segments.zh: 这些只是你安全检查清单上的一小部分项目。

segments.text: But hopefully this gives you a better idea of the type of things you'll be looking
segments.zh: 但希望这能让你更清楚地了解你要找的

segments.text: for in your survey.
segments.zh: 是哪类东西。

segments.text: Now head to the lab and get started.
segments.zh: 现在去实验室开始吧。

segments.text: Thanks for watching.
segments.zh: 感谢观看。
